response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(res.points) AS total FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t), sel AS (SELECT t.name, t.total, a.avg_total FROM t JOIN a ON t.total > a.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total) FROM sel) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE r.name IN (SELECT name FROM sel)) AS avg_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(total - avg_total) FROM sel) AS avg_excess_over_average_total
